common_name: Maui Giant Picture-Winged Fly (9.5 mm Wingspan & Supernumerary Crossvein Network)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila cyrtoloma (4.3 µm, detail scale)

specimen.provenance: Byte copy of datasets/species_gallery/II_Anaima_Invertebrata/Drosophila_cyrtoloma.jpg. Commons had no CC bitmap of this species on 2026-10-27.

kinetics.equation_u: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + gamma * (a - u + u^2 v)
kinetics.equation_v: dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + gamma * (b - u^2 v)

reported_in_source: Turing 1952 dispersion conditions and the critical-wavenumber formula
Edwards et al. 2007 wing-pattern diversity of Hawaiian picture-winged Drosophila
Loeschcke, Bundgaard & Barker 1999 wing and thorax size reaction norms of D. buzzatii
Church & Extavour 2022 phylotranscriptomic discordance of Hawaiian Drosophila
reconstructed_in_script: Assignment of a 4.315 µm detail-tier carrier to D. cyrtoloma cuticular melanin
Diffusion-ratio and diffusivity-scale hypotheses that place buzzatii at 7.84 µm and deflecta at 6.05 µm
Grid calibration that sets the nonlinear selected wavelength of the focal simulation equal to 4.315 µm
Use of the gallery spiral plate as a frozen long-wavelength prepattern
does_not_claim: That 4.315 µm was measured on D. cyrtoloma by Edwards, Hardy, Magnacca, or Schnakenberg
That D. buzzatii is a geological ancestor of D. cyrtoloma or that D. deflecta is its descendant
That the gallery plate is a published micrograph or a CC photograph of a pinned adult
That DOI 10.11646/zootaxa.2400.1.1 is a paper about this fly
